sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.12

Fixes a display problem introduced in 4.5.11.

  • Stray styling text and a second loading spinner no longer appear below the store and sign-in pages. On some site themes, 4.5.11 showed a block of technical text and an extra "Loading..." spinner under the storefront. Updating to 4.5.12 removes it.
